description: tools.list with a `q` that can match nothing. The list is EMPTY (`[]`, never null) and the table's own sentence rides with it, byte for byte, because a filter that matched nothing and a build with no tools are different answers and only the reader knows which it is looking at. The sentence belongs to the layer that saw the filter: an UNFILTERED empty list carries no statement at all, and a non-empty one never does — a decoration on every answer would make the sentence mean nothing.
